question: Separate decoder boundary erosion from conditional spatial calibration and GT-box support mismatch.
sample: 1000 random train2017 images, seed20260922, exclude the previous800fit+200selection. First500 exploration, next500 confirmation; no tuning on either. Original COCO backbone saw train2017; these are held out only from refiner/template training.
mapping: Fixed original prediction candidates. Same-class maximum Box IoU>=0.5 owner; drop raw identities owning multiple GT; one representative per GT chosen by highest Box IoU then raw id. No mask-quality or confidence ranking for representative choice. Does not claim official AP matching.

decoder: same binary and rescaling, threshold>0.5 instead of byte cast
logits: shared2 applied only inside GT bbox (GT-assisted probe)
shared2 applied only outside GT bbox (GT-assisted probe)

measurements: matched four-region pixel changes relative to same decoder baseline
conditional residual by base logit bin and normalized ROI center/ring
instance size, predicted-box quality, fill fraction, and input support
correction parameters and signed spatial effects
statistics: Paired image-cluster bootstrap1000 for prespecified contrasts, report exploration/confirmation separately; descriptive confidence intervals not AP intervals. No training or test-time method selection.
decision: If gains vanish under only decoder threshold change, prioritize resampling compensation; if spatial gain persists and changes center/ring error in expected direction, continue conditional calibration and support probes. GT support oracle cannot be deployed.
budget: First1000 held-out diagnostic; two legacy fit images for code smoke. Subsequent experiments chosen by findings and separately recorded, not automatic declaration of mechanism.
